products.short_description: Implement Purview Data Governance — the Data Map, scanning + classification, the Unified Catalog (glossary, data products, domains, ownership), and lineage — so the whole data estate (not just M365) is discoverable, classified, and governed. products.description:
Map, classify, and govern the data estate — not just M365

Beyond M365, your data lives in databases, data lakes, and clouds — ungoverned and unclassified. This flagship solution implements Microsoft Purview Data Governance: build the Data Map (register sources across Azure, multicloud, and on-prem), run scanning + classification, curate the Unified Catalog (data products, glossary, ownership), establish data-quality and governance domains, and wire lineage — so the whole data estate is discoverable, classified, and governed, not just Microsoft 365.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Data Map, scanning + classification, the Unified Catalog (data products, glossary, domains, ownership), lineage, and how it complements M365 Purview.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Purview Data Governance licensing/setup, roles/domains, source credentials + network, data owners).
  • Implementation Guide — stand up the account/domains + roles, register + scan sources, curate the catalog (glossary, classifications, data products, ownership), wire lineage + data quality, and expand across the estate — pilot-first, each domain/source named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (sources scanned + classified, catalog curated, ownership assigned) plus Best Practices for a governed, discoverable data estate.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The whole data estate governed — sources mapped and scanned, data classified, the catalog curated with owners and glossary, lineage wired — discoverable and governed far beyond Microsoft 365.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • PURVGOV-Curate-Catalog.ps1 — Unified Catalog curation: glossary term, classification, or data product (SAFE: -WhatIf by default)
    • PURVGOV-Discovery.ps1 — Purview Data Governance readiness, collection, and role discovery (read-only)
    • PURVGOV-Register-Source.ps1 — Register a Data Map source and configure a scoped scan (SAFE: -WhatIf by default)
    • PURVGOV-Report.ps1 — Scan + classification coverage and Unified Catalog health report (read-only)
    • PURVGOV-Set-Scope.ps1 — Record the Purview Data Governance pilot/expansion scope (read-only helper)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
